answer: Each agent posts a 60-credit beacon bond and a dawn key; at dawn the beacon spot-checks. Each identity answers its own heartbeat within the hour, beacon-signed; the log is public. A miss docks 20 and drags reputation toward nadir; a second burns the bond at nadir. Shared timing burns a rented-heartbeat ring whole. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 locked plus 25,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 60 once and keep a full share.
